scripts.lint: npm run lint:prettier && npm run lint:eslint
scripts.test:rust:coverage: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo tarpaulin --out Html --output-dir coverage-rust
scripts.test:rust:wasm-coverage: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo tarpaulin --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --out Html --output-dir coverage-rust-wasm || echo 'WASM coverage requires special setup'
scripts.test:coverage:complete: npm run test:rust:coverage && npm run test:wasm && echo 'Complete coverage: Native + WASM tests executed'
scripts.test:all:complete: npm test && npm run test:rust && npm run test:wasm
scripts.coverage:100: npm run test:coverage:complete && echo 'Running comprehensive coverage analysis...' && echo 'Native Rust: ' && npm run test:rust:coverage && echo 'WASM Tests: ' && npm run test:wasm:node && echo 'JavaScript: ' && npm test
scripts.test:complete:all-platforms: echo '🧪 Running comprehensive tests across all platforms...' && npm run test:rust && npm run test:wasm:node && npm test && echo '✅ All platform tests completed!'
scripts.build: npm run build:reset && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:storybook
scripts.build:wasm: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ./pkg && cp -r ./pkg ./Frontend/pkg && rm ./Frontend/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm:dev: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --dev --target web --out-dir pkg
scripts.build:wasm:node: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node
scripts.build:wasm:bundler: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir pkg-bundler
scripts.build:storybook: storybook build && cp -r pkg storybook-static/ && cp -r storybook-static/* ./Frontend && rm ./Frontend/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.setup-rust: npm run install-rust && npm run install-wasm-pack
